name: Mochizuki Ayame
source:
A lonely, cynical, cool beauty

A classmate of Kazuhiro's. She left a strong impression on Kazuhiro from the moment they first met. She is a girl who lacks reality, and to put it better, exudes a mysterious aura. She always speaks and acts in a way that distances her from others, which makes her an outcast in class. Because of this, she is often alone, and outside of class she is often seen reading in her seat in the classroom, in the library, or on the roof of the annex where no one comes. She is the daughter of a wealthy man in town, and although many people blatantly slander her out of jealousy, she doesn't seem to mind at all. Although she never shows it on the surface, she is also a girl who is kinder than most.
